info.name: Maestro Crown College - Mobile App API
info.description: Maestro Crown College API. Folders A-D are the admissions v1 API and the public CMS. Setup, credentials and how-to: docs/ADMISSION_AND_CMS_GUIDE.md. Endpoint reference: docs/ADMISSIONS_API.md. Run the admissions folders in order (A, then B, then C).

request.description: Multi-role app login for Students using student_id.
Log in with teacher_id. Saves the token, replacing any earlier one. Student-only endpoints return 500 with this token.
Log in with phone_number. Saves the token, replacing any earlier one. Student-only endpoints return 500 with this token.
Email login for student accounts only (role_id 7). Returns 201.
Retrieves the currently authenticated user.
KNOWN ISSUE: currently returns 500 and the token stays valid. See API_DOCUMENTATION.md section 11.
WARNING: sets status to 0 on the logged-in account, so it can no longer log in. Restore seeded accounts with: php artisan db:seed --class=CreateUsersSeeder

item.name: 2. User Profile

request.description: Retrieves full student details: class, section, school, running session.
Send all five fields. Missing name causes a 500; missing gender, phone or address are saved as null.

formdata.description: Choose an image file in the Value column.

request.description: The field must be named user_image. KNOWN ISSUE: returns 201 but does not save the new photo. See API_DOCUMENTATION.md section 11.

item.description: Student accounts with an enrollment only. Teacher, guardian and new-applicant tokens get a 500 here. Log in with 'App Login (Student)' first. A 400 'not found' message means the account has no data yet, not that the request is wrong. (Existing mobile API. See docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md.)

List of exams with timings and status (Upcoming/Expired).
Exam results, mark sheets, and teacher remarks.

item.name: A0. Guardian flow (app): details, email OTP, apply
item.description: Same steps as the website: programme, guardian details, a 6-digit code by email, then apply. Step 3 saves {{guardian_token}}; step 4 uses it. In testing, code 123456 works; in production use the code from the email.

request.description: Shows the fees, seats and deadline on the first guardian screen.
Emails a 6-digit code. Valid 10 minutes. Call again to resend.
Returns a token with the applicant and guardian abilities. Saved to {{guardian_token}}.
The candidate phone must equal the guardian phone. The guardian is saved as the primary guardian. Then continue with the documents, submit and pay calls in folder A.

item.name: A. Admissions v1 - Applicant (mobile app)
item.description: Full applicant journey. Run top to bottom. Each request saves the values the next one needs.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit code. In local development the code is returned as data.debug_otp (never in production).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.debug_otp) pm.collectionVariables.set('otp_code', j.data.debug_otp);

request.description: Returns a token with the "applicant" ability. It is saved to {{applicant_token}}.
Public. Saves the Playgroup programme id to {{program_id}}.

exec: const p = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.code === 'PG-2026'); if (p) pm.collectionVariables.set('program_id', p.id);

request.description: Phone must be the one verified in steps 1 and 2. Date of birth must suit the programme age limits (Playgroup: 3 to 4).
Every guardian needs a name, relation and an 11-digit phone number.
Choose a JPG/PNG/WEBP file (max 1 MB) in the file row. Saves the document id.
Choose a PDF/JPG/PNG/WEBP file (max 5 MB). Files are checked by their content, not their name.
Checks fields, guardian, documents, eligibility and deadline. Moves to PENDING_APP_FEE (fee > 0).
The amount is set by the programme (500 BDT). The request cannot change it. Saves the transaction reference.

exec: const p = pm.response.json().data.payment; pm.collectionVariables.set('payment_ref', p.transaction_ref); pm.collectionVariables.set('payment_amount', Number(p.amount).toFixed(2));

request.description: Mock gateway only. The pre-request script signs the callback with the shared secret, as the real gateway does. A wrong or missing signature returns 422.
Shows status, documents, payments and (after approval only) the admission pass.
Allowed before enrolment. Use only when you want to test withdrawal.
Needs a TRACK code first (see request 14). Wrong details always return the same generic 404.
Sends a code for tracking. Saves the debug code in local development.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.debug_otp) pm.collectionVariables.set('track_code', j.data.debug_otp);

item.name: B. Admissions v1 - Council & Desk (staff)
item.description: Staff sign in first. Each request needs its own permission. Use the matching login.

request.description: Sets {{council_token}}. Council members can decide but cannot enrol.
Sets {{officer_token}}. Officers verify documents and enrol.
Sets {{principal_token}}. Read-only oversight, plus capacity override.
Needs admission.report.view.
Optional query: status, program_id, search, from, to, min_score, max_score, per_page.
Needs admission.application.view.
A rejection needs review_notes. When every required document is verified, the application moves to UNDER_REVIEW.
APPROVED issues the admission pass. Rejected and waitlisted need remarks. A full programme forces WAITLISTED.
Needs admission.enroll.
Shows capacity and available seats for the programme.

exec: const s = pm.response.json().data[0]; if (s) pm.collectionVariables.set('section_id', s.id);

request.description: Creates the Student ID (MCC26S...). Calling again returns the same student. The council member who decided cannot enrol.
Checks validity; does not reveal personal data.
Owner or staff only.
Only after approval and while the pass is valid. Amount from the programme (12000 BDT for Playgroup).

exec: const p = pm.response.json().data.payment; pm.collectionVariables.set('payment_ref', p.transaction_ref); pm.collectionVariables.set('payment_amount', Number(p.amount).toFixed(2));

item.name: D. CMS (public read-only JSON)
item.description: Published website content for apps. No login needed.

request.description: Only published notices inside their publish/expiry window.
Published gallery images.
group: GOVERNING_BODY, TEACHER or STAFF.
Returns 404 if the page is not published.

item.name: E. LEGACY admission endpoints (deprecated)
item.description: Old public endpoints. They create student accounts with random passwords and have no OTP check. Kept only for the existing app. Use folders A to D for new work. Planned removal after the mobile app switches to v1.
